title: (PSG) Project survival gila
description: Modpack for people who are doing the PSG challenge
body:
Overview

This modpack is designed to enhance overall performance and stability in Minecraft survival gameplay. It focuses on reducing lag, improving frame rates, and providing a smoother experience during long survival sessions.

The pack is particularly optimized for players who attempt PSG challenges, where consistent performance and fast world loading are essential.

Features

- Performance-focused optimization
- Reduced lag and improved frame stability
- Lightweight mod selection to maintain vanilla-like gameplay
- Optimized for long survival sessions and challenge runs

Goal

The primary goal of this modpack is to deliver a stable and efficient Minecraft experience without significantly altering the core survival mechanics of the game.
